title: 第3章 葬剑谷深第4章 残剑共鸣
lines: 痛。
深入骨髓，撕裂灵魂的痛。
这是云澈恢复意识后的第一个，也是唯一的感觉。
冰冷，粘稠的雨水无情地拍打在他的脸上，混合着泥土和血腥味，灌入他的口鼻，带来一阵窒息般的呛咳。
每一次咳嗽都牵扯着全身的伤口，尤其是后背脊梁的位置，那里空落落的，仿佛被人生生挖走了核心，只剩下一个虚无的血洞，不断吞噬着他的生机和温度。
他像是一袋被随意丢弃的垃圾，脸朝下趴在冰冷的泥泞里。
费尽全力，才勉强抬起仿佛有千斤重的眼皮。
入目所及，是一片昏沉、压抑的天地。
灰蒙蒙的天空如同浸了水的抹布，不断向下倾泻着冰冷的雨线。
四周是嶙峋的怪石，扭曲的枯木，以及……随处可见的森森白骨。
有些白骨还保持着持剑的姿势，有些则早已碎裂，与泥土砂石混在一起，分不清彼此。
空气中弥漫着腐朽、荒败的气息，更有一股无形无质，却又无处不在的“锋锐”
之意。
那是残留的剑气，纵横交错，偶尔划过皮肤，带来细微却清晰的刺痛感。
【葬剑谷】
青岚宗禁地，弃尸、流放罪大恶极之徒的绝地。
据说谷底深处埋葬着无数断剑残兵，积郁的剑气千年不散，修为不足者踏入，顷刻间便会被绞杀。
这里，是生命的禁区。
而他，云澈，前宗主之子，曾经的天之骄子，如今像条死狗一样被扔了进来。
“呵呵……哈哈哈……”
他想笑，喉咙里却只能发出破风箱般的嗬嗬声，带着血沫。
真是地狱模式开局啊。
剥骨之刑那撕心裂肺的痛苦，如同噩梦般在脑海中循环播放。
云昊那得意的狞笑，苏清瑶那冷漠的眼神，云海那虚伪的正义面孔，还有台下那些曾经对他阿谀奉承，转眼间就鄙夷唾弃的嘴脸……一幕幕，清晰得刻骨铭心。
恨吗？
当然恨！
恨意如同毒火，灼烧着他的五脏六腑，几乎要将他从内而外焚成灰烬！
但比恨意更汹涌的，是铺天盖地的绝望和无力感。
修为被废，剑骨被夺，身受重伤，被弃绝地。
这配置，简直是天崩地裂，连退婚流废柴模板都比他有前途！
至少人家只是退婚，他这是连根都让人给刨了！
为什么？
凭什么？！
父亲，你到底在哪里？如果你还在，他们怎敢如此对我？！
脑海中浮现出父亲云啸天威严却又不失慈祥的面容。
content_en:
pain.
The pain that penetrates deep into the bone marrow and tears the soul.
This was the first and only feeling that Yun Che had after regaining consciousness.
The cold, sticky rain slapped mercilessly on his face, mixed with the smell of earth and blood, and poured into his mouth and nose, causing a suffocating cough.
Every cough involved wounds all over his body, especially the area on his back, which was empty, as if the core had been dug away by life, leaving only an empty blood hole, constantly devouring his vitality and warmth.
He looked like a discarded bag of garbage, face down in the cold mud.
After exerting all his strength, he could barely lift his eyelids, which seemed to weigh a thousand pounds.
As far as the eye can see, there is a drowsy and depressing world.
The gray sky was like a water-soaked rag, pouring down lines of cold rain.
Surrounded by jagged rocks, twisted dead trees, and... white bones can be seen everywhere.
Some of the bones still maintained the posture of holding the sword, while others had long been broken into pieces and were mixed with the soil, sand and gravel, making it impossible to distinguish them from each other.
The air is filled with the smell of decay and desolation, and there is also an invisible, yet ubiquitous "sharpness"
meaning.
It was the residual sword energy, criss-crossing and occasionally scratching the skin, bringing a subtle but clear stinging sensation.
【Buried Sword Valley】
The forbidden area of Qinglan Sect, a place where corpses are abandoned and those who have committed the most heinous crimes are exiled.
It is said that there are countless broken sword soldiers buried deep in the valley. The accumulated sword energy lasts for thousands of years. Anyone with insufficient cultivation will be strangled in an instant if they step into it.
This is the restricted area of ​​life.
And he, Yun Che, the son of the former sect master, once the proud son of heaven, was now thrown in like a dead dog.
"Hehe...hahaha..."
He wanted to laugh, but all he could make was a roaring sound like a broken bellows, with blood foam in it.
What a hell-mode start.
The heart-rending pain of the bone-stripping torture played on a loop in my mind like a nightmare.
Yun Hao's proud smile, Su Qingyao's indifferent eyes, Yun Hai's hypocritical and righteous face, and the faces of those in the audience who once flattered him and then turned to contempt and contempt in the blink of an eye...the scenes were so clear that they are unforgettable.
Hate?
Of course I hate it!
Hatred was like poisonous fire, burning his internal organs, almost burning him to ashes from the inside out!
But what is more turbulent than the hatred is the overwhelming feeling of despair and powerlessness.
His cultivation was ruined, his sword bones were taken away, his body was seriously injured, and he was abandoned.
This configuration is simply earth-shattering. Even the loser model who broke off the engagement has a better future than him!
At least they just broke off the engagement, and he had his roots dug out!
Why?
Why? !
Father, where are you? If you were still here, how dare they do this to me? !
The majestic yet kind face of his father Yun Xiaotian appeared in his mind.
title_en: Chapter 3: Deep Sword Burial Valley Chapter 4: Resonance of the Broken Sword
